title: [finding] sys_organization is 「组织」 in the framework's zh-CN object bundle, while the console calls it 「工作区」; the bundle loads at kernel:ready after a host's bundle, so a host cannot override it
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2773 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2786). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The maintainer accepted, for the cloud console, two collective nouns only: 「工作区」 = the organization, 「环境」 = the instance (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 1 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2773). Cloud changed every string it owns (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2786). Three surfaces still say 「组织」, because they are the framework's translated object and a host cannot override them:
- the small label beside the workspace title;
- the breadcrumb;
- the action 「退出组织」.

## Evidence

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts:512`:
  - `sys_organization` label / pluralLabel 「组织」;
  - actions 创建组织 / 编辑组织 / 删除组织 / 退出组织;
  - ja-JP and es-ES twins.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/plugin.ts` loads this bundle in a `kernel:ready` hook, after a tenant plugin's init-time bundle. The merge is a deep merge where the last writer wins, so a host bundle entry for the same keys is overwritten.
- Measured on cloud's in-process control-plane boot: the served zh label is 「组织」.
- objectui already says 「我的工作区」 for the same thing (objectui#8669 settled the `organizations.*` family on "workspace").

## Options (not chosen here)

- (a) The framework's zh vocabulary for `sys_organization` becomes 「工作区」. This is framework-wide, so it touches every ObjectStack app that shows the object.
- (b) A declared host translation-override layer, applied after platform bundles, so a host such as cloud can rename a platform object for its users.

## Delivery note

Cloud's framework pin is held at `56bf27affb` until the v18 move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so a fix reaches cloud with that move.

Dedupe: searched objectstack for `sys_organization` zh translation, 组织 / 工作区 and host translation override. Only closed, different cards matched: #20462 and #20493 (untranslated leaves), #8094 and #20402 (other org surfaces).
